about_the_game:
Purchase this DLC to host The Binding of Isaac: Four Souls games. Other players do not need to purchase it to join.

2-4 Players | 30-60 mins

Recommended Age: 13+

The race for four souls has begun—are you ready?

Step into a world where every card played can change the tide of the game. Players choose characters with unique abilities and items, using loot cards, treasure cards, and dice rolls to battle monsters, earn rewards, and hinder their opponents.

The gameplay is as much about forming (and breaking) alliances as it is about your own strategy. Will you cooperate to take down a tough monster or sabotage your "allies" for personal gain? With dynamic player interactions, the game evolves constantly, ensuring no two matches are ever the same.

Key Features:

  • Unique Character Abilities: Select from 11 distinct characters, each with their own starting items, offering diverse strategies to explore.

  • Card Variety: Over 300 cards, including loot, treasure, and monsters, provide endless combinations and surprises.

  • Dice-based Combat: Engage in battles that rely on both luck and preparation, ensuring tension in every roll.

  • Social Strategy: Barter, bluff, or betray—player interactions drive the game as much as the cards themselves.

  • Replayability: Randomized decks and dynamic gameplay ensure fresh experiences with every match.

Sharpen your strategy, embrace the chaos, and see if you can outwit, outlast, and outplay your rivals.
